source("./code/not_functions/libraries.R")

```{r}
dir1<-"./data/extern/pit/"
folders<-list.files(path=dir1)
for (i in 1:length(folders)){
  dir2<-paste0(dir1,folders[i],"/")
  files<-list.files(path=dir2)
  for (j in 1:length(files)){
    dir3<-paste0(dir2,files[j])
    file<-read.table(dir3,header=FALSE,sep='\t')
    file<-as.data.frame(file[substr(file$V1, 0, 1) == "D", ])
    file<-as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(file[,1], "\\s+", 12))[,c(2,3,6)]
    colnames(file)<-c("Date","Time","tag_code")
    file$event_date_time_value<-round_date(as.POSIXct(paste(file$Date,file$Time),format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS",tz="GMT"),unit="1 second")
    file<-file %>% dplyr::select(-Date,-Time)
    file$event_site_code_value<-sub("\\s+[^ ]+$", "", files[j])
    if (i==1 & j==1){data=file} else{data=rbind(data,file)}
  }
}
remove(dir1,dir2,dir3,file,folders,files)
data$event_site_code_value=tolower(data$event_site_code_value)
data$antenna_id="01"
data$antenna_group_configuration_value=100
data<-data[startsWith(data$tag_code,"9")==TRUE,]
```

```{r}
comp_obs <- compress(cth_file = data)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
gate_onder <- read_excel("./data/extern/valves/valves2023.xlsx", sheet = 1)[,c(2,3)]
gate_boven <- read_excel("./data/extern/valves/valves2023.xlsx", sheet = 2)[,c(2,3)]

gate_cleaning<-function(data){
  colnames(data)<-c("date_time","opening")
  data$date_time <- round_date(ymd_hms(data$date_time),unit="1 second")
  start<-min(data$date_time,na.rm=TRUE)
  stop<-max(data$date_time,na.rm=TRUE)
  seq=as.data.frame(seq(start,stop,by=1)) #Time interval with steps of one second
  colnames(seq)="date_time"
  gate <- left_join(seq,data[which(duplicated(data$date_time)==FALSE),], by=c("date_time")) 
  gate$opening<-na_interpolation(gate$opening,option ="linear")
  gate$open=FALSE
  gate$open[which(gate$opening>2.55)]=TRUE
  gate$open_lag<-dplyr::lag(gate$open)
  open<-which(gate$open!=gate$open_lag & gate$open==TRUE & gate$open_lag==FALSE)
  gate$periode=NA
  k=1
  for (i in open){
    gate$periode[i]=k
    k=k+1
  }
  gate <- gate %>% fill(periode, .direction = 'up') %>% dplyr::select(-open_lag,-open,-opening)
  gate$since_open<-with(rle(gate$periode), sequence(lengths)-1)
  gate <- gate %>% dplyr::select(-periode)
  return(gate)
}
  
gate_onder<-gate_cleaning(gate_onder)
gate_onder$node<-"vdz onder"
gate_boven<-gate_cleaning(gate_boven)
gate_boven$node<-"vdz boven"

gate<-rbind(gate_onder,gate_boven)
remove(gate_onder,gate_boven)

comp_obs<-left_join(comp_obs,gate,by=join_by(min_det==date_time,node==node))
```

## Aantal individuen (unieke tags) op onder en boven antenne gedetecteerd

```{r}
comp_obs %>% 
  group_by(node) %>%
  summarise(unieke_tags = n_distinct(tag_code))
```

## Tijdstip eerste detectie per vis op onder en boven antenne

```{r}
comp_obs %>% 
  group_by(node,tag_code) %>%
  summarise(eerste_detectie=min(min_det))
```
